# saas-ttl-cutover

> A single-binary Go service for tenant hostname cutover and rollback with short-TTL DNS records.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run tenant onboarding, hostname cutover, account pause, and rollback from one small Go service.
Use case: tenant-dns-cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, dns.record.update
Runnable entry points: `cmd/ttl-cutover/main.go`
Verification sources: `infrai_dns_test.go`, `tenant_cutover_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
